build_belief_state_model: build a bidirectional transformer model using BeliefStateWrapper with forward and backward decoders
create_text_dataset: create a TextSamplerDataset that randomly samples sequences from text data for language modeling
train_model_gradient_accumulation: train a belief state transformer with gradient accumulation and periodic validation
generate_text_forward: generate text forward from prompt tokens using model.generate_with_suffix_cond with cache_kv enabled
generate_text_backward: generate text backward from prompt tokens using decode_backwards flag and reverse the output
